evidence.finding: Stored strain energy defines stress derivatives and reversible constitutive work in the ideal hyperelastic model.
For energy per reference volume W(F), the first Piola stress is P=partial W/partial F (plus constraint reactions where applicable); along an elastic path, P:F_dot=dW/dt.
